name: Cyient Ltd

ledger.quote: In the long term, in the medium term, we expect ASIC turnkey to be above 50% of the revenue mix.
ledger.speaker: Ramya Mohan
ledger.target: ASIC turnkey above 50% of revenue mix
ledger.verdict: ASIC turnkey target of over 50% revenue mix in the medium term remains pending.

ledger.quote: At the end of FY27, the revenue mix should be that the ASSP business, which is the third business, the custom product IP business, thanks to Kinetic will be almost 50% of our business, or 50% to 55%.
ledger.speaker: Ramya Mohan
ledger.verdict: Target for ASSP business to reach 50-55% of revenue mix by FY27 remains pending.

ledger.quote: We stick to our commitment of delivering flat EBIT for organic business by the end of next year. That's the goal we are working towards.
ledger.speaker: Ramya Mohan
ledger.verdict: Commitment of delivering flat EBIT for the organic business by end of next year remains pending.

ledger.quote: we are looking at somewhere around 15%-20% growth consistently year-over-year from that particular business alone.
ledger.speaker: Ramya Mohan
ledger.verdict: Target of 15% to 20% consistent year-over-year growth from custom products remains pending.

ledger.quote: In this sort of business, mid 45% to 50% margin is definitely possible. And that's where I think we will end up next year as well for this business.
ledger.speaker: Suman Narayan
ledger.verdict: Gross margin target of 45% to 50% by next year remains pending.

ledger.quote: Looking ahead, our markers remain unchanged from the last quarter, which is consistent revenue growth over the next 4 quarters, integrating Kinetic Technologies, an ASIC pipeline of over $100 million by Q4 and becoming EBIT neutral in FY27.
ledger.speaker: Krishna Bodanapu
ledger.verdict: Management pushed the semiconductor breakeven timeline from FY27 to FY28.
ledger.evidence: Now, in terms of breakeven, it looks like breakeven will happen only in FY28 and if you look at a gross level it has a very healthy gross margin.

ledger.quote: We expect the Kinetic transaction to close in March or April, and then the integration will start.
ledger.speaker: Krishna Bodanapu
ledger.target: Close Kinetic transaction in March or April
ledger.verdict: Kinetic transaction closed on schedule and was fully consolidated in Q1 FY27.
ledger.evidence: Q1 was the first quarter where we operated this recently acquired business, fully consolidated it, and the combined revenue of Cyient and the Kinetic Technologies business is $17.9 million.

ledger.quote: This program will be executed over the next 2 years.
ledger.speaker: Sukamal Banerjee
ledger.target: Execute asset management program over 2 years
ledger.verdict: Execution of asset management program over two years remains pending.

ledger.quote: So on FY27, as I've mentioned before, we will continue that commentary, which is we are aspiring for mid- to high single-digit organic growth year-over-year.
ledger.speaker: Sukamal Banerjee
ledger.target: mid- to high single-digit organic growth
ledger.verdict: FY27 mid to high single-digit growth target remains pending after Q1 CC revenue fell 0.9% YoY.
ledger.evidence: This in year-over-year turned out to be -0.9% constant currency and in rupee terms, it turned out to be a 10.6% growth in constant currency.

ledger.quote: I think if we are aspiring towards 15% EBIT now by Q4 of FY, that will translate to almost 17%, 17.5% EBITDA anyway, right?
ledger.speaker: Shrinivas Kulkarni
ledger.verdict: Management postponed reaching the 15% EBIT margin target beyond Q4 FY27.
ledger.evidence: We are still working towards a 15% EBIT, but we now believe that this may take a little longer than the Q4 FY27 we originally aimed for.

ledger.quote: On a normalized basis, we expect the tax rate to be in the range of 27% to 27.5%.
ledger.speaker: Shrinivas Kulkarni
ledger.verdict: Full year tax rate guidance of 27% to 28% remains pending after Q1 reached 29.2%.
ledger.evidence: We are working on initiatives to bring this down and we expect the full year run rate of ETR to be between 27% and 28%.

ledger.quote: So data collection is a massive opportunity with a very limited runway for next 2 to 3 years.
ledger.speaker: Harjott Atrii
ledger.verdict: Plan to capture data collection opportunity over next two to three years remains pending.

open.quote: We are working on initiatives to bring this down and we expect the full year run rate of ETR to be between 27% and 28%.
open.speaker: Shrinivas Kulkarni

open.quote: our overall attempt should be to narrow the gap, if not make it flat for this particular quarter. That is what we are working towards.
open.speaker: Sukamal Banerjee

read: Management has successfully delivered on strategic transaction execution like closing Kinetic Technologies on schedule. However, key profitability milestones have been pushed back, with both 15% EBIT margin and semiconductor breakeven targets delayed into FY28.
questions: When do you expect DET organic constant currency growth to return to positive territory?
What specific revenue levels are required to achieve semiconductor EBIT breakeven in FY28?
What is the revised quarterly margin trajectory toward achieving 15% EBIT in FY28?
bull: Group revenue grew 21.3% YoY in INR terms to Rs 2076 crore in Q1 FY27.
Kinetic Technologies acquisition was fully consolidated, adding $10.4 million in Q1 FY27 revenue.
Transportation and mobility grew 14.8% YoY in constant currency, delivering five consecutive growth quarters.
bear: Management delayed the 15% EBIT exit target beyond Q4 FY27 into FY28.
Semiconductor EBIT breakeven target was pushed back from FY27 to FY28.
DET revenue contracted 0.9% YoY in constant currency during Q1 FY27.
